title.original: Formal Security Analysis of Agent Protocol Composition
title.zh: 智能体协议组合的形式化安全分析
title.en: Formal Security Analysis of Agent Protocol Composition

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentThread 将规范到 TLA+ 再到真实 SDK 反例重放串成自动保证流水线，可复用于协议及其组合的安全审计。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentThread links specifications to TLA+ and executable SDK counterexample replay in an automated assurance pipeline reusable for protocols and compositions.

abstract.zh: AgentThread 将 Agent 协议规范文本编译为 TLA+ 不变量和模型，再把模型检查器反例通过适配器重放到真实 SDK。
abstract.en: AgentThread compiles agent-protocol specification text into TLA+ invariants and models, then replays model-checker counterexamples against real SDKs through adapters.

problem.zh: Agent 工具调用和委托协议的安全要求分散且执行不一致，单独审计规范或代码都难发现跨协议组合后的责任空白。
problem.en: Security requirements for agent tooling and delegation are scattered and inconsistently enforced, while specification- or code-only audits miss responsibility gaps under composition.

approach.zh: 框架从来源文本提取分层安全范围和检查项，形式化为不变量，先模型检查，再把可执行反例映射到生产 SDK/参考 Server。
approach.en: The framework links checks to source text, formalizes layered security requirements as invariants, model-checks them, and maps executable counterexamples to production SDKs and reference servers.

system_design.zh: 两阶段检查器包含规范解析与来源链接、TLA+ 模型生成、反例缩减、协议适配重放和按“要求/建议/责任缺失”分类的报告。
system_design.en: The two-phase checker combines source-linked specification parsing, TLA+ generation, counterexample reduction, adapter-based replay, and reports separating requirements, recommendations, and ownership gaps.

key_results.zh: 在五种新兴协议上，AgentThread 同时发现规范级问题、SDK 实现失败和仅在协议组合时出现的额外缺陷，且跨协议执行责任普遍未分配。
key_results.en: Across five emerging protocols, AgentThread finds specification issues, SDK failures, and additional composition-only defects, with cross-protocol enforcement responsibility largely unassigned.

limitations.zh: 保证受规范文本完整性、抽象模型和适配器保真度限制，状态空间爆炸也会约束更复杂工作流与开放实现的覆盖。
limitations.en: Assurance is bounded by specification completeness, model abstraction, and adapter fidelity, while state-space explosion limits coverage of more complex workflows and implementations.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
